== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Chon Ma is the highest-ranking [[Underlord]] within the [[Blackflame Empire]]. A physically imposing man, he fights using two black one-handed hammers and moves through the sky by stepping upon dark clouds that form beneath his feet. During combat, he has been observed engaging in aerial battles and has faced opponents from [[Redmoon Hall]]. Despite being wounded in battle, he is noted for his ability to deliver speeches regarding honor.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Chon Ma is a bear of a man who can be seen scowling beneath a cloud. He has a cut on his face that causes him to bleed.}}
